title: Client-side crash during automated network configuration. [API Error: An unknown error occurred.]

triage_metadata.reasoning: The reported crash and API error (EAI_AGAIN) occurred after executing a local VPN setup command (wg-quick) on a device with IPv6 disabled, which disrupted host networking and DNS resolution. This issue stems from local network and environment configuration failures rather than a systemic defect in Gemini CLI. Additional actionable reproduction details or logs demonstrating a systemic CLI defect independent of local network disruption are needed to proceed.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. The crash and connection error (EAI_AGAIN) appear to be caused by local network disruption following VPN configuration commands (wg-quick) on a system without IPv6 support. Please provide additional reproduction details or CLI logs showing a systemic bug in Gemini CLI that can be reproduced independently of local host network configuration failures.
